book.name: 1 KORIN
book.title: Tup ŋendehei ŋaiye Pol nainge nal lenge Korin

content: Pol ŋende wah nato Korin topoꞌe bongol tikin Got, yukur bongol kitikin
Lenge toꞌ tatai ŋam, ŋendeheiyeh ŋaiye ŋam matme yip ŋaiye ŋam manange malaŋatme wusyep tase tikin Got pe, ŋam yukur manange wusyep mut mar luluwe, topoꞌe sande tekeꞌe ŋembere, pakai.
Ŋupe ŋaiye ŋam top yip marp pe, yukur ma mininge wusyep ende topoꞌe, pakai. Ŋam ŋoiheryembe Jisas Krais ilyehme, topoꞌe nule kin nal loutungwarmbe.
Taꞌe luku pe, ŋupe ŋaiye ŋam marp topoꞌme yip pe, ŋam bongol pakai, topoꞌe ŋam hiꞌ gwarnge pe, hip syep ŋam dolndol.
Ŋam yukur mat ŋaiye ma mininge malaŋatme wusyep gunde sande tekeꞌe topoꞌe bongol ŋam tanam, pakai. Kom ŋam mat topoꞌe bongol tikin Yohe Yirise.
Ŋam mende taꞌe luku no, ŋam masande ŋoihmbwaip yip ka teŋei e unuh me bongol tikin Got. Yukur ka si e unuh sande tekeꞌe titinge lenge miyeꞌ.
Yohe Yirise pwal poi ŋoiheryembe topoꞌe sande tekeꞌe bwore tikin Got

Kom lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip tinge teŋei bongol me Got pe, poi manange malaŋatme sande tekeꞌe tikin Got malme tinge. Ki yukur natme miyeꞌ ondoh, topoꞌe lenge miyeꞌ kekep eꞌe, ŋaiye ka talai.

Kut teter ŋaiye Got yukur ŋende kekep eꞌe pe, kin si ŋoiheryembe yaŋah ende sai ŋaiye ya murp mi moto yirise kin. Miꞌe pe, tukwini poi manange malaŋatme sande tekeꞌe leꞌe, topoꞌe ŋoihmbwaip bwore bwore tikin Got ŋaiye somohon sai tase.
Taꞌe luku pe, yukur miyeꞌ ondoh ende gah kekep eꞌe sisyeme yaŋah uku. Ŋaiye ka sisyeme pe, yukur ka yuluwei Lahmborenge ŋaiye kin bongol yirise yil loutungwarmbe.
Ki taꞌe wusyep tikin Got ŋanange taꞌe leꞌe.

content.text: Ŋembep miyeꞌ yukur ka etekeꞌe, topoꞌe mungwim yukur ka usyunde,
topoꞌe miyeꞌ yukur ka ŋoiheryembe ŋaimune ŋaiye
Got si ŋende miꞌmiꞌ me lahmende ŋaiye ŋende nihararme kin.

content: Yohe Yirise nato nahaiꞌe ŋoihmbwaip tase tikin Got. Taꞌe luku pe, Got pwal poi Yohe Yirise ŋaiye ka oworꞌe ember ŋoihmbwaip tase tikin Got otme poi.

Yukur miyeꞌ ende ka etekeꞌe ŋoihmbwaip meleꞌe miyeꞌ ende, pakai. Yipihinge tikin miyeꞌ uku ŋilyehe sai tatame ka sisyeme, topoꞌe ki ŋahilyeh nal me Got, Yipihinge tikin Got ŋilyehe sai tatame ka sisyeme ŋoihmbwaip kin.
Taꞌe luku pe, yukur poi mambaꞌe yipihinge kekep eꞌe, pakai. Poi mambaꞌe Yipihinge tikin Got ŋaiye kin nember nat no, ya sisyeme yitini bwore bwore ŋaiye Got pwal poi pakaiye.
Wusyep ŋaiye poi manange pe, yukur miyeꞌ pwal poi sande tekeꞌe, pakai. Yohe Yirise pwal poi sande tekeꞌe ŋaiye poi manange wusyep Yohe Yirise mal lenge miyeꞌ ŋaiye Yohe Yirise narp tinge.

Lahmende ŋaiye Yohe Yirise pakai pe, yukur ka ambaꞌe ŋaimune ŋaiye natme yipihinge tikin Got. Detale, kin yukur tatame ŋaiye ka iyarꞌe ŋoihmbwaip tikin Yohe Yirise pe, kin ŋoiheryembe nange ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe luku pupwa homboꞌe.
Miyeꞌ ŋaiye Yohe Yirise narp kin pe, kin tatame ŋaiye ka iyarꞌe ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme, kut yukur miyeꞌ ende tatame ka iyarꞌe miyeꞌ uku.
Wusyep tikin Got ŋanange taꞌe leꞌe,

content.text: Lahmende tatame ka sisyeme ŋoiheryembe tikin Lahmborenge?
Topoꞌe lahmende tatame ka inime ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe ŋaiye ka ende?

content: Kom poi Kristen miyeꞌ tuweinge sisyeme ŋoiheryembe tikin Krais.

footnotes.text: 2.15 Wusyep uku sai nal tup syeꞌ.
